boundary.source: Statistics Canada 2021 Census Cartographic Boundary Files, PR - lpr_000b21s_e
boundary.sourceQueryGeneralization: Existing official Esri query used maxAllowableOffset=0.02 and geometryPrecision=5; no further simplification performed here.
boundary.repair: Shapely make_valid(method='structure', keep_collapsed=False) on source invalid rings; retain polygonal land, discard only collapsed zero-area geometry.

water.method: Subtract all preserved 1:50m lake polygons intersecting Canadian cartographic boundaries, including cross-border lakes. Smaller water bodies absent from this source are unresolved.

method: Union all 13 Canadian cartographic province/territory polygons; subtract intersecting preserved lake polygons. Coastal waters, neighboring countries and represented lakes excluded.
limitations: Boundary and water scales do not support cadastral precision.
Natural Earth 1:50m lake data do not resolve every small water body.
